title: Assorted Fruit Sours (2oz)
body:
Craving a snack that’s both fun and flavorful? Meet our Assorted Fruit Sours! With an irresistible mix of apple, orange, and lemon flavors, these sweet and tangy treats satisfy every craving and are perfect for any occasion.

Key Features and Benefits:

  • A Burst of Flavor Variety

Take your taste buds on a fruity adventure with our vibrant assortment of apple, orange, and lemon sours. From the juicy sweetness of apple to the zesty zing of lemon, there’s a flavor to match every mood.

  • Perfectly Portable Size

Packed in a convenient 1.5oz serving, these sours are made for life on the go. Toss them in your bag for a midday pick-me-up, enjoy them during a road trip, or share them at your next gathering.

  • Premium Quality Ingredients

Crafted with care, our Fruit Sours are made with high-quality ingredients for just the right balance of sweet and tangy. They’re satisfying without being overpowering—making them a crowd-favorite snack.

  • Freshness That Lasts

Thanks to resealable packaging, the deliciousness doesn’t stop after your first handful. Keep your sours fresh and flavorful for multiple snacking sessions, whether you savor them slowly or indulge all at once.

Experience the bright, bold taste of Assorted Fruit Sours today. Whether you’re treating yourself or sharing with others, these little bites of happiness are sure to bring a smile. Reseal, save, or savor—your snack time just got sweeter!

title: Cold Packs and/or Cold Shipping Insulated Box (Choose From Dropdown)
body:
When shipping items during warm-weather months or to warm-weather climates, we recommend all heat sensitive items be shipped via expedited (2 business day or quicker) service. You can add 6oz cold packs for $1 each to help protect products from the heat, or for better protection, you can add an insulated box (with ice pack included) for $6.50.  When you choose the insulated box option, we use thermal cool shield bubble liner to completely line the inside of your box, which helps keep the products and the cold pack(s) colder for longer. 

Please ensure during warm weather months or when shipping to warm-weather climates that someone is available to receive the package when it is delivered. On average, ice packs last up to 24 hours and will not last longer than 48 hours. Ice Packs will last the longest when traveling inside an insulated box. 

Please consider purchasing ice packs or an insulated box to help protect heat sensitive products (such as chocolate, product with gelatin, and products that contain marshmallow) as the United States Postal Service does not consider melted candy to be a damage claim. 
Please see our Shipping Policies for additional information on shipping to hot weather areas.

Key Features

Inside each bag of Trolli Sour Brite Eggs, you’ll find chewy sour gummies encased in a tantalizingly crunchy candy shell—an ideal balance of textures that’ll keep your taste buds on their toes. Available in three playful flavor duos—Cherry-Lemon, Strawberry-Grape, and Orange-Lime—you’re in for a fruity rollercoaster with every bite.

Taste Experience

Prepare for a mouthwatering explosion of flavors! Each piece starts with a tangy sour kick, perfectly balanced by a sweet, fruity rush that makes you crave more. It's a taste adventure that’s thrillingly unpredictable yet addictively satisfying.

Versatility

Trolli Sour Brite Eggs are as versatile as they are delicious. Perfect for snacking during a movie night, sharing at parties, or jazzing up desserts like ice cream sundaes or cake toppers. These gummies turn any moment into a vibrant, flavor-packed celebration.

Bring Home the Fun

Why settle for ordinary when you can indulge in the delightfully strange? Grab a bag of Trolli Sour Brite Eggs today and treat your taste buds to the ultimate sweet-and-sour thrill they’ve been waiting for!

  • Share or Save: Packaged in a convenient 12oz resealable bag, these candies are perfect for savoring over time or sharing with friends, family, or even at a romantic Valentine’s party.
  • Versatility Meets Fun: Enjoy these candies on their own, use them as adorable party favors, or get creative by adding them as decorative toppings to your favorite desserts. They’re perfect for any festive occasion!

Make Valentine’s Day Sweet and Sour!

title: Caramel Apple Pops (one)
body:
Caramel Apple Pops – A Classic Treat

These delightful green apple lollipops are coated in a layer of irresistibly soft, chewy caramel, offering a perfect balance of tart and sweet flavors in every bite.

Why You’ll Love Caramel Apple Pops

The vibrant green apple base is the ultimate ode to fall nostalgia, while the luscious caramel coating brings a comforting sweetness that melts in your mouth. The contrasting textures—a satisfyingly hard lollipop paired with creamy caramel—make each pop a uniquely delicious experience.

Convenient, Fun, and Versatile

Relish the joy of caramel apples wherever you are! Caramel Apple Pops are perfect for on-the-go snacking, a quick pick-me-up, or as a treat to share with friends and family. Individually wrapped for freshness, they work equally well as Halloween goodies, party favors, or sweet treats for school lunches.

title: 100 Grand Bar
body:
100 Grand Bar - A Classic Delight Revisited

Step back in time and savor a piece of confectionery history with the 100 Grand Bar. Originally known as the $100,000 Candy Bar when it first tantalized taste buds in 1964, this beloved treat has stood the test of time, capturing the hearts—and palates—of candy lovers everywhere. The 100 Grand Bar is more than just a chocolate bar; it's a nostalgic trip down memory lane, wrapped in a delectable, mouth-watering package.

Perfect Balance of Sweetness

What makes the 100 Grand Bar truly special is its impeccable balance of sweetness. The combination of chewy caramel, rich milk chocolate, and crunchy crisped rice creates a harmonious blend that's neither too sweet nor too mild. It's the perfect treat for those moments when you need a little pick-me-up or a satisfying end to your meal.

Whether you’re rekindling childhood memories or discovering this classic for the first time, the 100 Grand Bar offers a timeless indulgence that's sure to please. Treat yourself to a 100 Grand Bar today and experience the perfect blend of chewy, rich, and crunchy goodness that has made it a favorite for generations.

Each bar 1.5oz.

title: Cry Baby Wax Bottles Candy 8-Packs

Product Overview

Step up your candy game with a treat that’s part sweet, part sour, and 100% fun! Cry Baby Wax Bottles are the ultimate nostalgic snack, delivering a thrilling burst of tangy liquid candy wrapped in quirky wax bottles that are sure to ignite your taste buds. Each pack of Cry Baby Wax Bottles comes with 8 bottles, each filled with an irresistibly sour liquid candy that’s perfect for anyone who craves a bold, tart flavor. The unique wax bottle design adds a layer of fun and playfulness to your snacking experience.

Features and Benefits

  • Sour Liquid Candy: These bottles are filled with a tangy, flavorful kick that sour candy lovers can’t resist.
  • Fun Wax Bottles: The quirky design isn’t just cool to look at—it also makes these candies an engaging treat to enjoy. Bite into the wax, savor the sour liquid inside, and feel the zing!
  • Shareable Goodness: With 8 bottles per pack, there’s enough to share with friends, bringing laughter and joy to any gathering.

Cry Baby Wax Bottles are perfect for any occasion—whether you’re throwing a party, reliving childhood memories, or looking for a fun way to brighten up your day. Enjoy them at the movies, as a road-trip snack, or even as a quirky addition to a candy buffet.

body: You'll have to take your time enjoying the Mackintosh Toffee Bar. A firm yet creamy toffee that is definitely meant to be savored. title: Mini Candy Sushi Platter
body:
A Sweet Twist on Sushi

Who says sushi can’t be sweet? The Mini Candy Sushi Platter is a playful and delicious reimagining of sushi that swaps savory seafood for colorful, chewy candies. Perfect for candy lovers and sushi enthusiasts alike, it’s a treat that’s as fun to eat as it is to gift.

Features You'll Love

Dive into a delightful array of 9 unique candy pieces carefully arranged in a charming plastic bento box. From gummy “nigiri” to marshmallow “rolls” and licorice “seaweed,” each piece adds a touch of whimsy to your snacking experience. Whether you enjoy them with chopsticks or your hands, these bright and playful sweets promise to catch both your eye and your taste buds. Net weight is 3 oz.

Flavors That Satisfy Every Taste

Sweet, sour, and everything in between! The Mini Candy Sushi Platter boasts a variety of flavors and textures to suit every craving. Tart gummies, fluffy marshmallows, and hints of licorice create a harmonious blend of candy creativity, offering a tasty surprise in every bite.

Allergy Information

For your safety, please note that this product contains coconut and wheat.

Treat Yourself or Someone Special

Whether you’re looking to indulge in a fun snack or find a unique gift for the candy lover in your life, the Mini Candy Sushi Platter is a surefire hit. Add a touch of sweetness to your day or brighten someone’s with this delightful confection that’s sure to start conversations and satisfy cravings!

title: Candy Lipstick - Swizzels Love Hearts Lipsticks (One)
body:
Bring Back Sweet Childhood Memories

Experience a nostalgic treat with Swizzels Love Hearts Candy Lipstick—a fruit-flavored sweet encased in a charming plastic case. Straight from the United Kingdom, this timeless treasure is every candy lover's dream come true. With one uniquely delightful lipstick randomly selected for you, every package is a sweet surprise.

Features & Benefits

  • Fruit-Flavored Perfection: Delicious, fruity flavor infused into a bite-sized treat that's perfect for satisfying sweet cravings.
  • Fun and Whimsical Design: Shaped like a lipstick, it’s a playful candy that stands out, making snack time a little more exciting.
  • Compact Convenience: Small and portable, it’s your go-to candy for on-the-go indulgence or to share.

Bursting with Tangerine Goodness

Among the fruity flavors, tangerine is a standout with its perfectly balanced tangy sweetness. This bold, citrusy taste evokes a burst of sunshine in every bite, delivering a flavor-packed experience that's unparalleled.

Iconic and Vibrant Packaging

The candy is packed in a playful and retro-inspired plastic lipstick case. Its colorful design not only completes the nostalgic aesthetic but also makes it a keepsake-worthy piece! Plus, the refillable packaging aligns with sustainable practices, adding a modern touch to its vintage charm.

Savor this candy lipstick any way you like—pop it in your purse as a fun treat, share it at parties, or include it in a retro-themed gift basket for friends and loved ones.
